meta.name: biopython
meta.description: Comprehensive molecular biology toolkit. Use for sequence manipulation, file parsing (FASTA/GenBank/PDB), phylogenetics, and programmatic NCBI/PubMed access (Bio.Entrez). Best for batch processing, custom bioinformatics pipelines, BLAST automation. For quick lookups use gget; for multi-service integration use bioservices.

copy.tagline: 处理分子生物学序列和自动分析生物信息数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常处理生物信息学数据，需要自动化分析流程。
copy.tagline_en: Manipulate molecular sequences and automate bioinformatics analysis.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly work with bioinformatics data and need automated analysis pipelines.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用 Biopython 库编写生物信息学代码：读取和转换 FASTA/GenBank 等文件、访问 NCBI 数据库、运行 BLAST，并产出可运行脚本。
howto.when: 当用户要求处理生物序列、解析 FASTA/GenBank 等文件，或访问 NCBI/PubMed 数据库时触发。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will use the Biopython library to write bioinformatics Python code: handling sequences, parsing FASTA/GenBank files, accessing NCBI, running BLAST, and generating runnable scripts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to handle biological sequences, parse FASTA/GenBank or other biological files, access NCBI/PubMed databases, or perform other bioinformatics tasks.

say_en.text: Use Biopython to read this FASTA file and compute GC content per sequence.
Use Bio.Entrez to search PubMed for recent literature on CRISPR.
Use BLAST to align this DNA sequence and show the top 5 hits.
